_comment: USMS age-group time standards for Swim Tools v2, used to seed realistic age-group data. Copied as-is from the USMS dataset in percentileTimes.js (scraped 2026-07-09 from usms.org event rankings, season 2025-2026). One slice per course, sex and age group: SCY only, Women and Men, 18-24 to 80-84. Each tier cutoff is the time at that percentile of the event ranking: row is its place in the list, rows_returned how many swimmers the list held. The rankings return at most 500 rows; where cap_hit is true the real field is bigger and that event's cutoffs run fast. No 25 Free or NQT. Not yet read by the page.
